purpose: Preserve fail-closed promotion while separating true engineering defects from stale-head safety refusals, non-applicable workflows, and known platform gates.

ACTIONABLE_FAILURE.required_recovery: actual log forensics and bounded repair

workflow_signal.rule: Only exact evidence may classify a workflow. UNKNOWN remains fail-closed and must never be painted green.

automatic_recovery: compare current head to exact verified head
reuse preflight evidence only when it names the exact current head
after exact-head evidence is restored, re-check fresh PR CI, reviews/comments, mergeability, architecture, security, licensing, provenance, privacy, and Product Reality policy

reconciliation_pr_routing.github_actions_role: derive live status, commit generated status, push only an authorized reconciliation source branch
reconciliation_pr_routing.portfolio_orchestrator_role: read the exact generated payload from the bot source head, re-materialize it onto a fresh orchestrator-authored promotion branch rooted at the current default head, run exact-head preflight, then create the PR and enforce normal PR CI/review gates
reconciliation_pr_routing.least_privilege_reason: Avoid broad GITHUB_TOKEN PR permissions and GitHub recursion suppression while keeping branch generation automated and fresh PR CI trustworthy.

diagnostic_churn.definition: A diagnostic investigation that explicit evidence says was already known to be non-actionable before the investigation began.
diagnostic_churn.use: Identify repeated scheduler effort spent rediscovering stale-head, non-applicable, or already-understood platform conditions.

safety: Do not convert stale or non-applicable state into GREEN.
Do not reuse suppressed checks from a bot-authored source commit as fresh PR CI for a different promotion head.
Do not let operational severity override repository-required CI or review gates.
Do not grant GitHub Actions broader PR authority merely to avoid a routing step.
